# QNX fixtures

`nfi-qnx6.zlib` losslessly compresses NFI qnxmount's `test_image.bin`; its matching
`nfi-qnx6.tar.gz` is the independent QNX-created file oracle. Original script
`make_test_fs.sh` is retained with trailing whitespace normalized. Source commit:
`11c8a7f9ee9b945d584263743f6ea8524e8776d2`, Apache-2.0, see LICENSE-qnxmount.
https://github.com/NetherlandsForensicInstitute/qnxmount/tree/11c8a7f9ee9b945d584263743f6ea8524e8776d2/tests/qnx6/test_data

`qnx4.zlib` and `qnx6-*.zlib` are invented CC0 field fixtures generated by
`scripts/qnx-fixtures.py`. They are not complete formatter/fsck outputs.
Checksums, uncompressed sizes and producer URLs are in manifest.json.
No private evidence or proprietary QNX tools are included.
